Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Vishnu Chemicals Limited reported strong Q1 FY27 results with over 20% year-on-year growth in operating revenue and PAT, supported by a strategic product mix shift towards higher value-added derivatives and steady performance in the barium and strontium segments. Management highlighted challenges from rising ocean freight costs and geopolitical tensions in West Asia, alongside a temporary maintenance shutdown at the Vizag facility during the quarter. Key future growth levers include upcoming capacities in specialty chemicals like DMSO, further backward integration, and the expected restart of South African mining operations in the second half of the financial year. The company remains focused on disciplined capital allocation, cost efficiency, and achieving its targeted 20% EBITDA margin over the long term. Vishnu Chemicals reported a strong start to FY27 with consolidated operating revenues growing 24.9% year-on-year to ₹433.4 Cr and PAT increasing 23.0% to ₹39.6 Cr, despite a planned maintenance shutdown at the Vizag facility.

guidance.claim: Management expects operations in South Africa to commence during the second half of this financial year.
guidance.quote: In South Africa, we are progressing with multiple activities required to restart operations, including refurbishment, engineering and stability assessments, recruitment, contractor mobilization, and we expect operations to commence during the second half of this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to continue to remain at 25% moving forward for the barium segment.
guidance.quote: I think we believe the EBITDA margins will continue to remain at 25% moving forward.

guidance.claim: Management expects the business to grow 15%, 20% this year in the barium division.
guidance.quote: Things we remain positive, and we expect it to grow 15%, 20% this year in the barium division as well.

guidance.claim: Management expects freight rates to gradually normalize over the medium term.
guidance.quote: We believe such levels are unsustainable, and we expect freight rates to gradually normalize over the medium term.

guidance.claim: Management expects to start commercial production of DMSO and chrome metal by next financial year.
guidance.quote: So we remain positive that we'll be able to start commercial production by next financial year.

guidance.claim: Better capacity utilisation for Strontium is expected in FY27.
guidance.quote: Better Capacity Utilisation expected in FY27

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that most barium products are linked to infrastructure growth and real estate in various regions.
demand_outlook.quote: because most of them are linked to infrastructure growth and real estate in those regions.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment for the leather industry continues to remain challenging.
demand_outlook.quote: I would say, well, I mean, generally, the demand environment for chrome, especially the leather industry continue to remain challenging.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is planning to add approximately 20 megawatts of solar power capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: We are planning to add approximately 20 megawatts of solar power capacity, which will increase our solar power generation capacity, nearly 6x from the current level, whereby the average power cost will come down significantly over the years.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project estimated capex for DMSO is between INR205 crores to INR240 crores, with INR68 crores spent up to June 30.
capex_expansion.quote: In DMSO, our total project estimated capex is between INR205 crores to INR240 crores, of which we have spent close to about INR68 crores up to 30th June.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that approximately INR50 crores will be invested in chromium derivative expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Chromium, we are expanding our derivative base. Almost INR50 crores will be invested over there.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the capital outlay for the South Africa business will be in the range of INR20 crores to INR25 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: South Africa business, the capital outlay will be very limited in the range of INR20 crores to INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that an investment of close to about INR40 crores is likely to complete backward integration projects in the barium business.
capex_expansion.quote: Barium business, we are expanding our backward integration line, and we are likely to see an investment of close to about INR40 crores to complete these projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Planned solar capacity addition is approximately 20 MW.
Acquisition for backward integration has been completed and integration is underway.
Strontium was commercialised in FY26 as an import substitute with customer approvals progressing positively.
capex_expansion.quote:
• Commercialised in FY26
• Import substitute
• Customer approvals progressing positively

margins_costs.claim: Operating revenues for Q1 FY27 reached INR433.4 crores compared to INR346.9 crores in Q1 FY26, a growth of 24.9% Y-o-Y.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, the company reported operating revenues of INR433.4 crores in Q1 FY27 compared to INR346.9 crores in Q1 FY26, a growth of 24.9% Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 stood at INR65.5 crores compared to INR55.7 crores in Q1 FY26, representing a growth of 17.5% Y-o-Y.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR65.5 crores in Q1 FY27 compared to INR55.7 crores in Q1 FY26, a growth of 17.5% Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 15.1% in Q1 FY27 compared to 16.1% in the corresponding quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 15.1% in Q1 FY27 compared to 16.1% in corresponding quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q1 FY27 stood at INR39.6 crores compared to INR32.2 crores in Q1 FY26, a growth of 23% Y-o-Y.
margins_costs.quote: The profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR39.6 crores compared to INR32.2 crores in Q1 FY26, a growth of 23% Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Higher value-added derivatives contributed nearly 50% of sales in the quarter gone by compared to 40% in FY26 as a year.
margins_costs.quote: And the higher value-added derivatives contributed to nearly 50% of our sales in the quarter gone by as compared to, say, 40% in FY26 as a year.

margins_costs.claim: Logistics cost was about 9% to 10% for the quarter gone by and could be upwards of 20% for the current quarter.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter gone by, it's about 9% to 10% is the logistics cost, but it is going to change quite a bit for this quarter. It could be upwards of 20%, depending on this.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for Q1FY27 stood at 44.7% compared to 45.6% in Q1FY26.
EBITDA margin for Q1FY27 was reported at 15.1%.
Solar capacity additions are planned to drive meaningful power cost savings.
margins_costs.quote: To drive meaningful power cost savings.

margins_costs.claim: Highest ever profitability was driven by strategic initiatives taken over the years with a focus on global cost competitiveness.
margins_costs.quote: Highest ever profitability driven by strategic initiatives taken over the years with focus on global cost competitiveness.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that operations in the barium business are running at optimum capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: Our barium business continues to perform consistently with operations running at optimum capacity utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the strontium business has a capacity of close to about 10,000 tonnes and is currently operating at 50% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: So yes, we have a capacity of close to about 10,000 tonnes in strontium business. We are currently operating at 50% utilization over there.

orders_capacity.claim: The existing solar capacity of the company stands at 4.3 MW.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that total debt in the books ending 31st March is about INR527 crores, with a debt-to-equity level of 0.49.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes. So our -- as per the balance sheet that we have reported ending 31st March, the total debt in our books is about INR527 crores. That includes our long-term borrowings and short-term borrowings, which is at a debt-to-equity level, so 0.49.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the total capex outlay for solar will be close to about INR5 crores to INR6 crores under an SPV model.
capital_allocation.quote: The total capex outlay for solar will be close to about INR5 crores to INR6 crores, and the rest will be under the SPV model, wherein we will be able to buy the solar at a fixed price on the longer term.

capital_allocation.claim: A dividend of 15% is subject to the approval of shareholders in the ensuing AGM.
capital_allocation.quote: *Subject to approval of shareholders in ensuing AGM

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow from operations increased by 40.8% YoY, reflecting robust earnings quality.
capital_allocation.quote: Cash flow from operations increased 40.8% YoY, reflecting robust earnings quality.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the geopolitical and logistics environment remain challenging at the current juncture.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical and logistics environment, however, remain challenging at this current juncture.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that ocean freight costs have increased sharply amidst ongoing geopolitical tensions in West Asia.
risks_headwinds.quote: While we have not experienced any significant supply disruptions, ocean freight costs have increased sharply amidst the ongoing geopolitical tensions in West Asia.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management reported a one-off expense in the barium segment where baryte prices were retrospectively charged for the last 2 years, resulting in a one-time impact of close to INR8 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: There was a one-off expense, which was factored in where the baryte prices were retrospectively charged for the last 2 years. It was an adjustment. Whereby there was a one-time impact for the last quarter close to INR8 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Robust performance was achieved despite a planned maintenance shutdown at the Vizag facility which impacted sequential performance.
risks_headwinds.quote: Robust performance despite a planned maintenance shutdown at the Vizag facility, which impacted sequential performance.

risks_headwinds.claim: There is challenging macroeconomic sentiment due to the West Asia crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: Challenging macroeconomic sentiment due to West Asia crisis.

risks_headwinds.claim: A sharp increase in ocean freight costs is visible, which are expected to normalise over the medium term.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, sharp increase in ocean freight costs visible, which are expected to normalise over the medium term.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects South African operations to commence during the second half of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: In South Africa, we are progressing with multiple activities required to restart operations, including refurbishment, engineering and stability assessments, recruitment, contractor mobilization, and we expect operations to commence during the second half of this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects commercial production of new specialty chemicals like DMSO and chrome metal to start by next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So we remain positive that we'll be able to start commercial production by next financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to enter into a long-term supply agreement for Chrome Oxide Green with a European client in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: In the coming months, we're going to enter into a long-term supply agreement for one of our key derivative Chrome Oxide Green to a European client.

management_commitments.claim: Ocean freight costs are expected to normalise over the medium term.
management_commitments.quote: However, sharp increase in ocean freight costs visible, which are expected to normalise over the medium term.

management_commitments.claim: Growth initiatives are expected to support sustainable medium-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: Our growth outlook is underpinned by multiple expansions across existing and new chemistries. These initiatives are expected to strengthen our competitive positioning and support sustainable medium-term growth while focusing on a customer-first approach.

management_commitments.claim: South Africa ramp-up is intended to support medium-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: South Africa ramp-up to support medium-term growth.

management_commitments.claim: Phased production for the backward integration acquisition is set to start from the second half onwards.
management_commitments.quote: • Phased production to start from H2 onwards

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
